Description: Savory fried dough knots finished with herbed garlic butter and parmesan, served with marinara. Impossible to stop at one.
Herbed ricotta, mozzarella, and parmesan stuffed into golden fried dough. The one that started it all.
Crispy pepperoni, melted cheese, and herbs sealed inside crispy fried dough. The proper way to serve pepperoni.
Cream cheese and Nutella folded into warm fried dough. Rich, indulgent, and worth every bite.
Fried dough knots tossed in cinnamon sugar and served with vanilla icing. A taste of childhood.
Botanical, creamy, and lightly spiced. Tea-forward with a smooth finish.
Bright and refreshing with juniper and citrus. Clean and alive.
Coffee-forward with a hint of lime and molasses depth. Bold and unexpected.
